meta.title: Competitor Radar
meta.niche: AI agents and automation for hotel front desk, guest service, and staffing operations

analysis.summary: Rivals mostly refresh existing pages, not publish new ones. Akia leads on AI guest-service content, and ALICE owns labor-cost research. Dextr has 1 new page and no updates.

points.text: Akia updated 38 older pages and added 5 new ones, with a heavy focus on AI agents and receptionists. That is the closest topic match to Dextr.
ALICE publishes labor-cost and profitability research, plus gated reports (free download pages). It speaks to owners and finance leads, not just front desk teams.
Dextr's only recent page is a Cloudbeds partner announcement. Rivals show far more content on AI, front desk, and staffing topics.

Dextr.play: One partner news post with Cloudbeds. No other recent content on AI, front desk, or staffing.

Canary Technologies.play: No page data in the last 30 days. Large site, with 233 templated /post/ pages.

ALICE (Actabl).play: Labor-cost and profitability reports, connected-hotel guides, and AI insight pages that point to its software.

Akia.play: Mass refresh of AI agent, messaging, and receptionist pages, plus guides on training the AI agent.
Akia.aimed: Hotels and vacation rental operators buying

Duve.play: Refreshed product pages and guides on front desk, guest experience, and tech choice. 27 pages were edited on one day.

Operto.play: Mostly refreshed pages on smart-home tech, Airbnb, and OTA (booking site) research. One AI award post.

shared.title: Refresh over new
shared.text: Akia (38), Duve (21), Operto (19) and ALICE (11) updated far more old pages than they published. This looks like a push to keep AI and product pages current.

shared.title: AI product landing pages
shared.text: Akia, Duve and ALICE each have AI-specific pages: AI receptionist, DuveAI, and Altitude. AI is now a standard product page, so Dextr needs clear proof to stand out.

shared.title: Buyer guides on picking tech
shared.text: Akia and Duve publish how-to pieces on choosing software and front desk tools. They aim at buyers who are still comparing options.

gaps.title: AI front desk vs staffing proof
gaps.text: Rivals split between guest messaging (Akia, Duve) and labor data (ALICE). Few tie AI agents to staffing hours saved. Dextr could own that link.

gaps.title: Hotel-focused AI agent how-tos
gaps.text: Akia has one guide on training its agent, but it leans toward vacation rentals. A hotel-first guide on rollout, handoff to staff, and limits is open.

gaps.title: Cloudbeds integration content
gaps.text: Only Dextr has a partner post. Setup guides, use cases, and results for Cloudbeds hotels are open for Dextr to build out.
